summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the grant of 1,281,929 restricted share units (RSUs) to 51 employees under its 2026 Share Plan, with a nil purchase price and no performance targets. The RSUs have a mixed vesting schedule of 15-54 months, benchmarked to HK$18.88 per Class A ordinary share. This is a routine equity compensation grant, not a special situation event, as it involves ordinary course employee incentive awards with no change in control, restructuring, or strategic transaction.
